svg.title: Figure 6-1: hazard-to-measure matrix
svg.desc: A grid with the fifteen hazards down the side, each with its adopted Performance Level in a coloured chip, and the measures across in four groups: design and complementary measures, operating-environment limits, safety functions and information for use; a dot marks each pair where the measure reduces the hazard.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 6-1 Which measure reduces which hazard, in the ISO 12100 order

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A dot where the §6 table says the measure reduces the hazard. Left to right: inherently safe design and complementary measures, operating-environment limits, safety functions, information for use.
